description: Pattform's shared Renovate preset. Repos extend it with { "extends": ["github>Pattform/.github"] }. Minor and patch updates are grouped into one PR per repo (saving CI minutes) and automerge once the PR's checks (the deploy preview, tests) pass; majors open a PR that waits to be merged from the portal.

customManagers.description: Capability versions pinned in deploy/ specs: kind LandingSite + annotation "1.0.0" is @pattform/capability-landing-site@1.0.0 on npm
The engine version the reusable deploy workflow runs (engine-version input default)

packageRules.description: Majors never automerge: their PRs wait for a merge from the portal
Our own packages ship straight away (no release-age wait)
Capability bumps change live infrastructure: one PR per repo (one preview, one deploy, Client first), labelled so the portal can tell them apart

Look up Docker official images (debian, node, eclipse-temurin...) on AWS's public mirror of them: Docker Hub rate-limits anonymous lookups per IP, and Cloud Run's shared IPs hit that limit, which aborts the whole repo. Only the lookup moves; Dockerfiles keep their image names.
npm follows Node: repos pin engines.npm to the npm bundled with their .nvmrc Node (lockfiles must match what CI and Amplify run), so it moves with the Node.js update, not on its own

One PR per repo for every minor and patch update: each PR runs the repo's CI, so grouping saves Actions minutes. Last on purpose, so it overrides the built-in monorepo groups for non-majors (majors keep them: parts of a monorepo must move together). Capabilities keep their own group, and majors stay one PR each.
